files.README.md:
# overnight jobs

`logs/payroll-loader.log` is written by the loader that posts the day's payroll
entries. Each line is `<UTC time> <level> <message>`; a post the upstream
service refuses is logged against `upstream=<service>` and retried a few times.

`logs/fleet-release.log` is written by the release tool. Each line records one
rollout as `<UTC time> INFO rollout service=<name> build=<n> nodes=<n> complete`,
and a service is rolled out at most once a night.
